title: 奥瑞利安·小星星风铃
description: 蓝紫星龙轻盘长身，低头观察一串小星星风铃，金色角冠和星云尾清楚可辨。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Aurelion Sol is an immense celestial dragon with a long serpentine blue-violet body, a proud feline-like dragon face, sweeping golden horns and head ornaments, and a flowing starry mane. Preserve his small forelimbs and graceful cosmic tail rather than turning him into a human mascot. Use soft wax-crayon stars embedded in his body, with friendly eyes and rounded contours.
art_direction.scene: Curl his long body into a loose open spiral that fits the square, leaving his head close to a tiny hanging star mobile. One delicate foreclaw nudges a small suspended star as if admiring a handmade version of the sky. A simple twilight cloud and warm paper space keep the cosmic scene playful and legible.
art_direction.palette: deep periwinkle, sky blue, pale gold, lilac
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
